narrative.details:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
narrative.objectives: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
narrative.requestItemsText: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.

mentionedItems.name: Sturdy Lumber
tooltip: "A shipment of lumber from Stranglethorn Vale that can be of use to your faction in Arathi Highlands."
